codelines.name: metrolinx
codelines.reason: This is the Metrolinx Next.js frontend that renders CMS content from Contentstack and is where the live-preview feature for the MX Homepage and Discover Article pages would be implemented, as indicated by the ticket's FE-only estimate and its MX component.
codelines.evidence: ticket component "MX"; repository uses Contentstack as its CMS (package.json dependency "contentstack": "^3.15.2" and extensive Contentstack service imports throughout src/)

facts.text: The pretest script runs 'npm run build:config' which uses esbuild to compile next.config.source.ts into next.config.js; tests will fail if this step hasn't run because next/jest loads next.config.js.
The build throws an error and aborts if CLOUDINARY_DOMAIN or CLOUDINARY_CLOUDNAME environment variables are not set (except in test env).
facts.source: next.config.source.ts: if (!CLOUDINARY_DOMAIN || !CLOUDINARY_CLOUDNAME) { throw new Error("Missing required environment variables"); }

facts.text: Jest enforces a global coverage threshold of 60% for branches, functions, lines, and statements; 'npm run test:coverage-check' will fail if any metric drops below 60%.
facts.source: jest.config.js: coverageThreshold: { global: { branches: 60, functions: 60, lines: 60, statements: 60 } }

facts.text: Commit messages must follow Jira-style conventions enforced by commitlint-plugin-jira-rules with extends 'jira'; non-conforming commits are rejected by the husky hook.
lint-staged runs 'npm run check-types' (tsc), eslint, prettier, and stylelint on staged files before a commit is allowed through.
